maddeler.e:
نلتهب (form VIII)
# نَلْتَهِبُ (naltahibu) /nal.ta.hi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَبَ (iltahaba)
# نَلْتَهِبَ (naltahiba) /nal.ta.hi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَهَبَ (iltahaba)
# نَلْتَهِبْ (naltahib) /nal.ta.hib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِلْتَهَبَ (iltahaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
